instruction.name: xvsrln.b.h
instruction.description: Logical right shift each unsigned 16-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 16, write the lower 8 bits of the shifted result into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 4.62 cycles. The measured CPI 0.5775 is the nominal 0.5 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
